## AgentStack Remote MCP Server

Backend platform for AI agents: one agentstack.execute tool runs batched steps over ~668 actions (hosting, storage, auth, payments, CRM, app builder).

### Authentication

OAuth 2.1 (Dynamic Client Registration + PKCE). Alternatively, pass an API key in the `X-API-Key` header.

Official MCP registry name: `io.github.agentstacktech/agentstack`.
